problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate resources from seven manufacturing hubs to seven distribution centers while minimizing total transfer expenses.

Each hub has a fixed production capacity, detailed as follows:
*Hub P1 can provide 107 units.
*Hub P2 can provide 57 units.
*Hub P3 can provide 131 units.
*Hub P4 can provide 75 units.
*Hub P5 can provide 135 units.
*Hub P6 can provide 87 units.
*Hub P7 can provide 85 units.

Each distribution center has a non-negotiable resource requirement:
*Center D1 requires 77 units.
*Center D2 requires 40 units.
*Center D3 requires 70 units.
*Center D4 requires 63 units.
*Center D5 requires 39 units.
*Center D6 requires 51 units.
*Center D7 requires 75 units.

The expense incurred per unit transferred between any specific hub and center is provided in the matrix:

| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 | D5 | D6 | D7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | 1  | 9  | 7  | 5  | 18 | 20 | 17 |
| P2 | 14 | 4  | 10 | 8  | 10 | 4  | 2  |
| P3 | 8  | 14 | 20 | 15 | 3  | 4  | 16 |
| P4 | 20 | 18 | 1  | 17 | 19 | 8  | 5  |
| P5 | 10 | 14 | 1  | 20 | 12 | 8  | 19 |
| P6 | 14 | 6  | 3  | 17 | 12 | 3  | 17 |
| P7 | 18 | 17 | 17 | 18 | 1  | 13 | 16 |

Determine the optimal allocation of units to be transferred, ensuring all requirements are met and capacities are not exceeded, so that the aggregate expense is minimized.
